title: GTA 6 Sales: 32.5M Copies. Are You One?
caption:
Take-Two says GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies and made $3.79 billion by the end of launch day (pre-orders included). GTA 5 made $816 million in its first 24 hours in 2013. That's 4.6x, our math.
Did you buy GTA 6 on day one, or are you waiting for a sale?

Sources: Take-Two / Rockstar Games (20 Nov) via CNN and TweakTown; Take-Two (GTA 5, 2013)
ig_first_line: $3.79 billion in one day. GTA 6 just made 4.6x what GTA 5 did on its first day.
